name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabs on Base UI's Tabs with Fluent 2's appearances (transparent underline, subtle wash, Byterygon's enclosed editor tabs) in small, medium and large, horizontal or vertical, with panels; tabs can carry a status icon, be closed with a button or Delete, be reordered by drag or Alt+Shift+Arrow, and carry a count in its own badge.

manifest.name: tabs
manifest.title: Tabs
manifest.description: Tabs on Base UI's Tabs with Fluent 2's appearances (transparent underline, subtle wash, Byterygon's enclosed editor tabs) in small, medium and large, horizontal or vertical, with panels; tabs can carry a status icon, be closed with a button or Delete, be reordered by drag or Alt+Shift+Arrow, and carry a count in its own badge.
manifest.usage: Use Tabs to switch between views of the same place: the sections of a Settings dialog (appearance transparent), or DBee's query tabs (appearance enclosed, size small). Compose it as Tabs (value, onValueChange) > TabsList > TabsTrigger per tab (value, icon for a status, children for the title) + TabsContent per tab. For closable tabs pass onClose on each TabsTrigger and keep the tabs in state (Tabs controlled): when the active tab closes, choose the next one. For a number that belongs to a tab (History 1,234, Errors 3) pass count on its TabsTrigger, never in the title: it is drawn in a Badge after the title, neutral unless countTone says it needs attention (danger, warning), hidden at 0 unless showZero, shortened from 10,000 (12.4k) with its full number in a title, and read with the title as one name (countLabel says what it counts: "History, 1,234 events"). For reorderable tabs pass onReorder(value, index) on TabsList and move the tab in your array. For navigation between pages use NavigationMenu or Sidebar; for a choice that filters content in place, ToggleGroup. The old variant prop (line is transparent) and the sm/md sizes still work for one release.

props.name: value
props.description: Tabs: the active tab (controlled); defaultValue when uncontrolled. TabsTrigger and TabsContent: the tab they belong to.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Tabs: called when the user activates another tab.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Tabs: Fluent's transparent (an accent underline under the selected tab) or subtle (a wash behind it), or Byterygon's editor-style enclosed tabs.

props.name: variant
props.description: The old name of appearance: line is transparent. Kept for one release.

props.name: size
props.description: Tabs: tab height from size.control.* (24, 32, 40 px comfortable). sm, md and lg still work for one release.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Tabs: the direction of the strip and of its arrow keys.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: TabsList: makes the tabs reorderable by drag and Alt+Shift+Arrow; move the tab to index.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: TabsList: the tooltip and accessible name of the button that lists the tabs that do not fit (the count is added to the name).

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: TabsList: as Base UI, activate a tab as soon as the arrow keys focus it.

props.name: icon
props.description: TabsTrigger: a leading status (running spinner, modified dot); give it a text alternative.

props.name: count
props.description: TabsTrigger: a number in its own badge after the title. Hidden when 0 (unless showZero), null or undefined; from 10,000 it is shortened (12.4k, 48k, 1.2M, cut and never rounded up) and the badge's title holds the full number.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: TabsTrigger: what the count counts, read after it in the tab's one accessible name ("events" gives "History, 1,234 events") and in the badge's title; a pair, ["event", "events"], says "1 event" for one.

props.name: countMore
props.description: TabsTrigger: there are more than count (the first page of a longer list): the badge reads "50+" and the name and title "at least 50 runs".

props.name: countTone
props.description: TabsTrigger: the count's tone, a Badge variant; use danger or warning for what needs attention, such as failures.

props.name: showZero
props.description: TabsTrigger: show a count of 0 (for a tab where none is itself the news, such as Consumers 0).

props.name: onClose
props.description: TabsTrigger: makes the tab closable (close button and Delete); focus moves to the neighbouring tab.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: TabsTrigger: the close button's title.

props.name: disabled
props.description: TabsTrigger: cannot be activated; shown in color.fg.disabled.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: TabsContent: keep the panel in the DOM while hidden (an editor's state).

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Wraps a tab and its close button; draggable when reorderable, with an accent line on the side a dragged tab will drop; data-slot="tabs-item".

slots.name: close
slots.description: The close button at a closable tab's end, out of the tab order and aria-hidden; data-slot="tabs-close".

slots.name: count
slots.description: The count's Badge after the title, aria-hidden (the number is read in the tab's name); data-slot="tabs-count".

parts.name: TabsList
parts.description: role="tablist" in a strip (data-slot="tabs-strip") that never scrolls: tabs that do not fit go to a "More tabs" menu at its end (Fluent's TabList overflow), the selected one always stays visible; onReorder makes the tabs movable; moreLabel names the menu button.

parts.name: TabsTrigger
parts.description: role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls: icon, truncated title, and a close button when closable.

states.name: active
states.description: The active tab: color.fg.default, an accent underline (line) or color.bg.surface (enclosed).

states.name: hover
states.description: A tab under the pointer: color.fg.default (line) or color.interactive.hover (enclosed).

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width inside the tab.

states.name: closable
states.description: A closable tab leaves room for its close button.

states.name: dragging
states.description: The tab being dragged, at opacity.disabled.

states.name: drop-target
states.description: The tab a dragged tab will drop next to shows an accent line on that side.

accessibility: The strip is role="tablist" of role="tab" elements with aria-selected and aria-controls; each panel is role="tabpanel" labelled by its tab. Only the active tab is in the tab order.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (ArrowUp and ArrowDown when vertical), Home and End move between tabs; Enter or Space activates the focused tab (or focus activates it with activateOnFocus).

A closable tab closes with Delete when focused (aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"); its close button is for the pointer, out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology so the tablist holds only tabs. Focus moves to the neighbouring tab.
A reorderable tab moves with Alt+Shift+ArrowLeft and Alt+Shift+ArrowRight (Up and Down when vertical), announced through aria-keyshortcuts, as well as by drag, so reordering does not need a pointer.
A status icon needs a text alternative (role="img" with aria-label, or visually hidden text), since a coloured dot alone carries no meaning.
Only colours transition; nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.

A count is a Badge hidden from assistive technology, and its number is read as part of the tab's one name through visually hidden text ("History, 1,234 events", the full number, with countLabel after it), so it is never read as a separate stop. The badge keeps its own fill and text pair on the selected, hovered and pressed tab, so its contrast does not depend on the tab behind it; its tone is never the only signal, since the number and its label say it.
